title: Testing MCP-Powered AI Agents: Security, Authorization and Quality Engineering Patterns
abstract: A practical framework for protocol, authorization, tool-risk, trajectory, approval, prompt-injection, tenant-isolation, observability and CI/CD testing for MCP-powered agent systems.

title: RAG Quality Engineering: A Practical Framework for Evaluating RAG Systems
abstract: A layered evaluation approach covering retrieval, context, groundedness, hallucination, citation integrity, authorization, freshness, performance, cost and regression quality.

title: Agentic AI for Quality Engineering
abstract: A practical architecture perspective on using specialised AI agents across requirement analysis, test design, automation, execution, review and governance.

title: Enterprise Playwright Architecture for Continuous Quality
abstract: Design principles for maintainable Playwright automation across UI, API, parallel execution, reporting and CI/CD quality gates.
